subject: Merge branch 'fulltext' into main
reason: The merge adds only non-functional content: a cspell word-list update, Markdown design docs under docs/full-text/ with a doc-scraping script, and skeleton C++ headers (src/indexes/text.h, src/indexes/text/*.h, src/indexes/text_index.h) sketching a future full-text index. No CMake/Bazel file or .cc file references any of the new headers, and several are not even valid C++ (e.g. 'public public' inheritance, 'void Next() = override;', includes of a nonexistent src/text/text.h), so they cannot be compiled into the module. The built module at the change is behaviorally identical to the parent; no c
